pr_title: Prevent errors when deleting multiple nodes
pr_body:
Fixes errors when attempting to delete multiple nodes at once and then switching between tabs. First by always setting the EditorInspector object to null when performing a deletion (this will clear the inspector since otherwise it still thinks its operating on multiple nodes), and secondly by detecting MultiNodeEdit objects in the editor history, and removing any history entries which touch missing nodes.

Closes #61683

issue_context.title: "Node not found" message for deleted children when reloading a scene
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

v4.0.alpha.custom_build [1baee2189]

### System information

Linux Mint 20.3, kernel version 5.15.0-33-generic

### Issue description

After deleting multiple children in my scene, whenever I switch tabs back to that scene, I will get a warning for each child telling me that the node could not be found.

![godotbug](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7575664/171980501-d468cede-21dd-4c4f-828e-3017917bf64d.png)

```
  Node not found: "Tile2" (relative to "/root/@@16215/@@656/@@657/@@666/@@668/@@674/@@680/@@681/@@682/@@704/@@705/@@745/@@746/@@9069/@@8890/@@8891/@@8892/@@8893/@@8894/@@8895/MainScene").
  Node not found: "Tile3" (relative to "/root/@@16215/@@656/@@657/@@666/@@668/@@674/@@680/@@681/@@682/@@704/@@705/@@745/@@746/@@9069/@@8890/@@8891/@@8892/@@8893/@@8894/@@8895/MainScene").
  Node not found: "Tile4" (relative to "/root/@@16215/@@656/@@657/@@666/@@668/@@674/@@680/@@681/@@682/@@704/@@705/@@745/@@746/@@9069/@@8890/@@8891/@@8892/@@8893/@@8894/@@8895/MainScene").
  Node not found: "Tile" (relative to "/root/@@16215/@@656/@@657/@@666/@@668/@@674/@@680/@@681/@@682/@@704/@@705/@@745/@@746/@@9069/@@8890/@@8891/@@8892/@@8893/@@8894/@@8895/MainScene").
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new project.
2. Create a main scene.
3. Create a scene for an object, in this case "Tile."
4. Bring many (I do 4) Tile instances into the main scene.
5. Save the scene and close the editor.
6. Reopen the editor.
7. Select all 4 tiles and delete them at one time.
8. Change tabs to a different scene (ex: the Player scene)
9. Change tabs back to the main scene and see the warnings. I've tested and for me they persist even after saving and reopening the engine again.

### Minimal reproduction project

Steps 1-5 were taken to produce this project. Start at step 6 to produce the bug
[bugdemo.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/8836986/bugdemo.zip)
